vetSays.line: A man, maybe 60s, with a scarred cheek heads out for water. "Water first. Everything else waits." Better close to the fire today.

👂 Overheard — A man, maybe 60s, with a scarred cheek: "You're right. I'll talk to the others."
👂 Overheard — A man, maybe 60s, with a scarred cheek: "Have you noticed how quiet it's gotten? People are scared to say it out loud."
A man, maybe 60s, with a scarred cheek hesitates, then backs off. "Not today. Sorry." (Low trust — reluctant.)
"Can we talk?" A man, maybe 60s, with a scarred cheek sits down near you. "Just... talk. Like people used to." (Talk to A man, maybe 60s, with a scarred cheek.)

👂 Overheard — A man, maybe 60s, with a scarred cheek: "Thanks for saying it. I'll check on people. Quietly."
👂 A man, maybe 60s, with a scarred cheek "You. Yeah, you. What do you make of this?"
👂 Overheard — A man, maybe 60s, with a scarred cheek: "Someone's been crying at night. Not naming names — just be kind today."

📺 "Oh, you survived the AUDIENCE NOTES? Cute. We've stopped pretending these are animals now. That was the FINAL DRAFT, folks — what comes out of the treeline next was never alive the way you mean it."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Gloria just put down The Callback... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Boris just put down The Terms of Service... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 "We've been watching you for a LONG time. Your faiths. Your formats. Your little institutions. So we built something out of... well. Out of YOU. Say hello to the MIRROR DRAFT."

◈ ARC IV — THE INEFFICIENCY. SYSTEM: "ROUNDING ERROR RECLASSIFIED: ANOMALY. Organic consumption yields impossible output. Recalculating. Recalculating." — They finally see it. The thing they laughed at — needing to EAT — is the engine. Their confusion is your weapon now. You stood up to the calibration fauna, the audience's notes, the Final Draft — lived through their Show, weathered the worst together, and built something bigger than a village. One day humanity will need a case to make. The case is made of deeds, not words — and yours, though unfinished, are undeniable. (Feasted buffs burn ho
📺 "But finales — FINALES need a LEGEND, sweetheart. More STANDING — blood, bonds, or bread — and look the Mirror Draft in the eye. The producers are WAITING."

◈ SYSTEM: "Four waves. FOUR. The producers are — okay, I'm saying it: FINALES need a NATION. You've got a region; now make it a REALM. Bind fires under one head, or bend the knee to someone who has. The higher-ups are watching. ...Did I say higher-ups? I said NOTHING. Forget the higher-ups."
★ IDENTIFIED: European Elder. Elder. Big shrub; flat white flower plates in June, drooping black berry clusters in late summer. Uses unknown — harvest, taste, and learn.
📚 Village knowledge: Ines taught everyone about European Elder. The Codex grows without you lifting a finger.
Ines is showing everyone European Elder by the fire. "See the leaves? Like that. Don't mix it up." The Codex grows — the human way.
The fire burns low. 2 new lines in the journal tonight — loudest: European Elder — named and noted.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Sal just put down Big Ugly... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 "You've gotten too big for the story. Ratings are GREAT, by the way — but you're threatening the narrative now. So the narrative is fighting back. Meet the PRODUCERS."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Marcus just put down Loud-Eyes... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🌿 European Elder — the foragers have handled it 8 days running. They know it now — which parts are worth hauling, which bruise, how it wants to be carried. The village's knowledge deepens.
💡 European Elder: the village knows more than you do. Harvest it a few more times (0/3) and it'll click.
Blooded — the village knows where the Producers bleed. (Strikes hit 1.5× as hard; their blows land at 0.75× strength.)

regDeaths.name: the absence of sound, shaped like wings
a soft green glow under the water
two knobs on glass-still water, watching
a heron that isn't quite there when you look at it
a boulder with opinions about where you're walking
the thing with headlights for eyes, standing too still
